nodes.label: FEA demo programs (conditional target list)
nodes.rationale: The FEA demo list is layered by solver and visualization availability: three demos have no dependencies, most implicit/beam/shell demos additionally require PARDISO_MKL (a direct sparse solver), and MUMPS/MATLAB variants exist purely to exercise alternative linear solvers on the same cable problem. Multiphysics demos require both PARDISO_MKL and the FEA_MULTIPHYSICS submodule.

nodes.label: FEAvisualization.h (shared FEA demo visualization helper)
nodes.rationale: Compiled into every FEA demo target as a shared UTILS header so that a single helper can dispatch to Irrlicht or VSG, which is what lets the same demo source build against either visualization module.
